implementationStatus: User scope selected: entire Taiwan main island plus retained mainland coast/Penghu/Kinmen/Matsu at1:1. No deployable runtime map, game-mode implementation, complete DEM import, sea nav graph or current-force deployment plan produced by this research.

preservedUserRequirements.scale: 1:1. Latest explicit Taiwan scope is the entire Taiwan main island; selected broad theatre also retains mainland coast/Penghu/Kinmen/Matsu. Do not shrink distances or substitute previous partial-island options.
preservedUserRequirements.conflict: Fictional two-team deployments and targets on real geography; no mapping of current real forces
preservedUserRequirements.eras: Era-separated rooms with shared allowed aircraft pool and era-specific weapons/sensors/ground units/AA
preservedUserRequirements.persistentCompany: Owned surviving AI continues last task while owner flies; surviving AI tank may be taken over without recreating damage/ammo/position.
preservedUserRequirements.roleSwitch: Friendly deployment area or vehicle loss.
preservedUserRequirements.airSpawns: Airport starts nearer selected combat front; airborne starts farther in the rear. Do not use teleporting forward air spawns to cancel map distances.
preservedUserRequirements.logistics: Light facility/transport-dependent service; no per-shot base stock accounting. Normal airport service10–20seconds when operational.
preservedUserRequirements.mobile: Same accepted world and entities; reduce rendering/network detail, do not delete companies or ships.

scopeInterpretation.meaning: Whole Taiwan main island; retained mainland coast/Penghu/Kinmen/Matsu make one real-scale cross-strait world. Nearby islands inside bounds are geography, not a demand to include all remote territories.
scopeInterpretation.previousChoices: Four partial/local alternatives are preserved for comparison only and do not remain pending selection. No further extent question is needed.
scopeInterpretation.geographyVersusScenario: Coasts, terrain, geographic airport points and distance calculations use sources. Team ownership, aviation use, deployment pockets, objectives, existing fronts/beachheads and standby transports are explicitly fictional game fixtures.
scopeInterpretation.coverageVersusDensity: Whole-world terrain coverage does not imply spreading16–24human players and their companies evenly over the entire theatre.

distanceMethod.input: Airport reference points from retained public-domain OurAirports snapshot; bounds are explicitly proposed design selections.
distanceMethod.rounding: Routes3decimals km, times2decimals minutes, extents2decimals km. This precision is calculation precision, not source positional accuracy.
distanceMethod.speedMeaning: Illustrative groundspeed only, not certified aircraft cruise or combat performance; actual game aircraft physics, fuel endurance, era/load and wind control sortie viability.

options.nameZh: 完整台湾本岛＋大陆沿海＋澎湖／金门／马祖

dimensions.note: Geodesic edge-centre distances and full bounds area including ocean; not island dimensions or land area.

options.mainland: 大陆沿海真实地域，涵盖已研究的厦门、泉州与福州沿海；所属设施和战役部队为架空，不复现当前军事部署。
options.taiwanMainIsland: 完整台湾本岛，包含北部、西部、南端、中央山地及花莲／台东东岸。
options.islands: 保留澎湖、金门、马祖；范围内的绿岛、兰屿及其他近岸岛屿采用实际地理。
options.notImpliedByFullTaiwan: 不自动扩展为全部行政附属或争议远方岛屿；东沙、太平／南沙及范围外其他远域不在这张地图。
options.gameplay: 全岛及海峡地形保持1:1并分块加载，每局选择一个主陆地战区与相邻海运／空中支援任务；8–12人每队总量不变，不平均分散到整座岛。
options.fictionalFrontRequirement: 60分钟局开局已有架空地面接触面／桥头堡、受控部署区及近海待命实体增援。它们是初始剧情状态，不是现实地理发现或现实军事部署。远距海运按实际航程执行，不把坦克跨水开行或瞬送。
advantages: 完整满足用户include full taiwan；旧局部范围只作成本／航程对照。
北西南东与离岛都能在同一地理世界中作为不同战局的任务地区。
保持真实航程、中央山地遮蔽／航线约束与有效海陆分离。
tradeoffs: 约463×537公里，必须使用地形流式加载、分层细节、远区实体调度与坐标精度管理。
桃园到高雄约291公里，700公里／小时直飞约25分钟；远处机场不是即时空中支援。
完整世界不意味着每局所有城市／机场都成为争夺目标；每局焦点部署需维持公平往返时间与玩家密度。

seaDistanceScaleComparison.meaning: Geographic-span arithmetic only; airports lie on land. A real game ship ETA must use a coastline-avoiding water-only route, draft/slope checks and loading/unloading time.

options.nameZh: 中部台海：泉州—澎湖—嘉义／台中
options.mainland: 泉州／晋江沿海及其陆地区域；厦门高崎机场在西界外。
options.taiwanMainIsland: 嘉义与台中一带的西部本岛及部分内陆；不是全台湾。
options.gameplay: 以台湾西部的一处连续陆地战线为主要坦克连战场，澎湖提供第二个独立岛屿战场／补给节点；大陆侧为可见可飞的实际地域与另一组后方设施。具体阵营控制与据点完全架空。
advantages: 同时保留大陆、澎湖和台湾本岛，台海主题完整。
澎湖与嘉义间约79公里，可形成比全海峡更短的真实空中支援航段。
较扩展南部方案少约三成矩形面积，便于先验证分块地形与海陆交通。
tradeoffs: 晋江到本岛机场214–235公里，700公里／小时下仍需约18–20分钟直飞。
主地图面积不等于活跃单位覆盖面积；坦克战必须集中在选定陆地战线。
金门可保留真实地形作为次要岛屿，不应把金门近岸短程战替代台湾本岛主战场。

dimensions.note: Width is geodesic west/east edge-centre distance; height is geodesic north/south edge-centre distance. Area includes ocean. Bounds select real geography; not the entire island.

A60min main-island scenario cannot wait for a complete long cross-strait voyage from a distant original shore.

options.nameZh: 北部台海：福州—马祖—桃园／新竹
options.mainland: 福州沿海及其陆地区域。
options.taiwanMainIsland: 台湾北部西岸，包含桃园与新竹区域，并包含台北松山机场；不含台湾中南部。
options.islands: 马祖列岛；不含澎湖与金门。
options.gameplay: 以北台湾的一处架空连续陆地战线为主，马祖作为独立小岛补给／侦察目标。主战线不用跨海连成一条坦克路线。

大陆、岛屿、本岛三层结构仍保留。
tradeoffs: 马祖机场跑道较短，不能默认支持全部喷气机；南竿约1579米、北竿数据约1150米，必须按载荷／机型验证。

大陆海岸与本岛仍被海隔开，必须另设架空陆地接触面才能提供开局坦克作战。

options.nameZh: 中南部台海：厦门／泉州—金门—澎湖—嘉义／台南
options.mainland: 厦门与泉州的沿海及陆地区域。
options.taiwanMainIsland: 台湾西部自台中向嘉义、台南及南侧部分区域；高雄国际机场在南界外，不含整个台湾。
options.islands: 金门、澎湖、望安、七美等范围内实际岛屿。
options.gameplay: 提供最大的跨岛战役空间，以一个本岛陆地战区为主、一个岛屿战区为辅，轮换而非让8–12名玩家每队同时铺满全部区域。
advantages: 保留厦门、金门、澎湖和台湾本岛的较完整台海辨识度。
多个真实机场候选，较适合后续不同年代和不同战役布局复用。
近岸短海运与远距海运可在同一真实地理框架下对比。
tradeoffs: 约316×288公里，海陆分块、渲染与传输预算高于另外两项。
厦门至台南约276公里，700公里／小时下约24分钟单程；早期喷气机往返与战斗燃油余量更受约束。
厦门至金门约27公里只代表机场点间距离，不能用这个数字暗示两岸本岛很近或船舶可直穿岸线。

options.nameZh: 厦门—金门局部（不含台湾本岛）

dimensions.note: Real-scale local subregion including mainland coast, Xiamen island, Kinmen and nearby water; not the full Taiwan Strait.

options.mainland: 厦门周边大陆海岸、厦门岛与实际跨岛道路；并非所有海上岛屿之间都有道路。
options.taiwanMainIsland: 完全不含台湾本岛；必须在地图选择和地图说明中明确。
options.islands: 厦门岛、金门与范围内邻近岛屿；不含澎湖、马祖。
options.gameplay: 以一个架空既有岛屿陆地接触面为坦克连主战区，短距离海运连接独立陆地区域。真实民用港口只是地理参考；游戏运输设施、所属与桥头堡为架空。
advantages: 约61×52公里，真实尺度下较容易适配45–90分钟一局。
厦门高崎至金门机场参考点约26.76公里，700公里／小时下直飞约2.29分钟。
两座实际机场候选与可验证的民用海上交通关系，为后续海陆交通原型提供依据。
tradeoffs: 没有台湾本岛，不能称为覆盖两岸本岛的完整海峡地图；需要用户知情选择。
高速喷气机短时间接近边界，需设计真实范围内的后方空域与转弯空间；不能压缩机场与空中出生距离规则。
海运较短仍需要实体承运、装卸与登陆设施，不代表坦克可跨水驾驶或凭空到达。
options.fictionalFrontRequirement: For immediate tank play, author an already-established fictional local land front; the compact map still contains separate land components connected only by valid sea transport or actual bridges.

roundAndTransitImplications.earlyJetConstraint: 500km/h illustrative groundspeed raises Jinjiang→Taichung one-way travel to25.70min.45min rounds must not assume a distant early-jet base can support many full return sorties. seaborneExamples.interpretation: Explicit game-design sea-leg examples, not measured routes between named actual ports. Valid coastline-avoiding routes, loading/unloading and manoeuvring add time. At20kn a60min round covers at most37.04km without those overheads; a200km leg takes≈324min.

roundAndTransitImplications.gameplayInference: User selected the full Taiwan main-island theatre. At1:1, large cross-strait sea passages exceed a45–90min round under the explicit20kn example; begin with fictional existing ground fronts and physically nearby/underway reinforcements, retain actual long voyages, and concentrate combat within one campaign focus region. Compact/local alternatives are historical comparisons only.
roundAndTransitImplications.sixtyMinuteFixtureRule: Selected full-island map: begin with fictional existing ground fronts/beachheads and physical nearshore standby transports with explicit time0positions/cargo. A20kn vessel covers only37.04km per hour before loading/unloading; strategic200km passage takes≈324min. Initial standby locations do not imply a full strait crossing happened inside this match. All later motion preserves geography and entity continuity.
roundAndTransitImplications.fuelAndReliefGate: At500km/h illustrative groundspeed, Taoyuan→Kaohsiung takes≈34.94min one way before climb/combat/return. Each era must use a valid closer controlled field for routine local support, with farther airborne deployment as previously agreed. Direct east/west reference lines across central mountains require terrain clearance; never treat the straight line as a guaranteed low-altitude route.

groundAndMaritimeFrontDesign.frontlineModel: Maintain one ground-front graph per physically connected land component. A ground front does not stretch as a traversable line over sea. Strategic objectives may connect components only through explicit transport operations.
groundAndMaritimeFrontDesign.suggestedStartState: For the selected full-island theatre, time0contains opposing fictional companies and owned deployment pockets on a chosen continuous main-island ground sector, with optional adjacent island/sea objectives. Existing beachheads and nearby standby reinforcement ships are authored initial game state, not current real positions. No exact real deployment/attack locations are selected in this study.
groundAndMaritimeFrontDesign.activeSectorBudget: Begin with one primary10–25km-scale contiguous land sector and one optional secondary island sector; terrain extent remains full1:1. Concentrate existing human/company budgets instead of inventing unlimited active formations over the entire bounding box.
transportLifecycle: Ground company moves along accepted land route to a friendly embark staging area.
Carrier capacity and permissible vehicle mass determine which surviving tank entities can embark.
Embarked tank entities retain owner/life/ammo/damage and cannot drive/fire as separate ground tanks.
Carrier follows a sea graph with coast/land exclusion, water depth/draft clearance, turning radius and valid ports.
Disembark only at an authored accessible friendly port or validated temporary landing facility with a supported ramp/contact mesh.
Disembarked entities rejoin the destination land graph; enemy control or destroyed access blocks new deployment until restored.
Transport destruction has explicit accepted cargo casualty/recovery rules; a lost company cannot silently reappear at its destination.
groundAndMaritimeFrontDesign.beachheads: Fictional initial lodgments or captured ports establish actual owned deployable areas. Port capture alone does not flip an island; companies still contest local roads/objectives and need a functioning supply connection. Temporary facilities must be visibly authored and physically usable.
groundAndMaritimeFrontDesign.longVoyagePolicy: Prefer some initial convoys already at sea with documented initial positions/cargo and visible ETA. Later departures may not finish this round; no hidden instant crossing. If an off-map strategic arrival queue is later used, label it as external theatre supply rather than a simulated completed voyage.
groundAndMaritimeFrontDesign.localSupply: Ground trucks on the destination landmass connect functioning port/depot/field service nodes to owned sectors. Losing bridges, ramps or depots interrupts valid routes and limits service availability.
groundAndMaritimeFrontDesign.bridges: Destructible bridges and temporary bridges apply to surveyed local land/water gaps with valid banks, load and slope; they never span the strait as a tank road.
groundAndMaritimeFrontDesign.commandAndIntel: Move/Attack/Defend commands check the correct land/sea multimodal graph. Tactical-map enemy markers follow discovery/shared intel/stale-position rules; transport routes cannot read omniscient enemy positions.
groundAndMaritimeFrontDesign.entityBudget: Ships, embarked cargo, mobile tanks and remote sectors remain in the same accepted simulation. Use authoritative coarse remote simulation and render LOD only after defining event invariants; never delete units merely because a mobile client cannot draw them.

landElevation.interpretation: Native representative tile successfully read3600×3600float32EPSG4326 at1arc-second. This proves sample coverage only, not complete selected-option coverage. DSM includes vegetation/buildings; roads/runways need validated terrain shaping and mesh evidence.
landElevation.fullCoverageGate: 36one-degree candidate cells intersect selected full-map bounds;23keys are present in downloaded publicGLO30tileList. Availability inventory is retained in research/taiwan-dem-availability.json. Only representative N23E119 data was actually read. Classify13nonlisted cells using proper coastline/ocean mask; do not declare complete terrain coverage before required land/void/datum checks and actual per-tile import.

coastlineAndRoads.candidate: Processed OSM coastlines/water/land polygons plus dated regional OSM roads/bridges/ports extracts
coastlineAndRoads.required: Do not use height==0 alone as the sea mask. Validate topological island separation, coastline continuity, bridge level/layer/access and road surface continuity with source DEM. A port tag is a geographic lead, not a verified loading terminal.

bathymetry.status: Source availability researched; no bathymetry subset downloaded and no navigable route certified.
bathymetry.limitation: ≈0.4–0.46km cells cannot prove a tank landing ramp, harbour shoal or individual ship draft clearance. Require finer compatible data or explicitly authored, tested local shoreline/port bathymetry. Copernicus ocean zeros are not seafloor.

metricWorld.proposal: Select local metric frame after extent selection; WGS84 geodesic distances remain the measurement reference. AEQD centred on the chosen extent is a candidate.
metricWorld.required: Quantify scale error over full117.80–122.35E/21.65–26.50N theatre; do not mix UTM50/51 eastings or degrees as metres. Define a stable global origin/axes, local metric conversion, vertical datum, water reference and floating-render-origin conversion.

realDataPipeline.performance: Hundreds of kilometres require streamed/LOD terrain, origin precision strategy and far-field simulation. Keep active-front geometry/collision precise while preserving actual travel distances. Prototype frame/network budgets before promising all named facilities fully modelled.

streamingFullTheatre.coverage: Full bounds are represented in the world/strategic map; streamed render/detail assets load around cameras, units, predicted flight corridors and campaign objectives.
streamingFullTheatre.candidateChunkPlan: Prototype hierarchical terrain cells, e.g.16km base cells with finer native-derived contact geometry near accepted interactions and coarser visual LOD at distance; this is an unbenchmarked design candidate.
streamingFullTheatre.precision: Use a stable global/geodetic authority plus documented local metric frames and floating camera/render origins; preserve deterministic coordinate conversion across server/native/WASM/replay. Quantify projection scale error across the full≈463×537km extent.
streamingFullTheatre.physics: Streaming visibility must not determine whether terrain/sea/bridges exist to accepted motion. Authoritative queries need valid terrain everywhere reachable and exact validated surfaces where vehicles interact; unsafe data holes block publication.
streamingFullTheatre.budget: Benchmark realistic16–24total human participants, company AI, aircraft, transports and remote simulation across the full world. Optimise renderer/mobile detail without deleting accepted entities or splitting a company into anonymous counters.
streamingFullTheatre.supplyContinuity: Ship cargo and nearshore standby reinforcements keep owner/life/ammo/damage and visible positions/ETA; carriers follow validated sea corridors. Local friendly port/depot supply links support the active sector while full-crossing strategic routes retain their long time cost.

recommendedDecision.selectionMeaning: Entire Taiwan main island plus retained mainland coast/Penghu/Kinmen/Matsu,1:1; do not re-ask partial extent choices.
recommendedDecision.implementationFocusRecommendation: Maintain the full streamed world and rotate one primary combined-arms sector per round. Exact fictional deployments, airport fixtures and ports remain authoring decisions subject to real terrain validation.
resolvedQuestions: Taiwan main island coverage is full, not partial or absent.
Previous compact/partial alternatives are comparison only.
remainingDesignFacts: 60min rounds require fictional existing ground fronts and nearshore standby physical reinforcements; long ocean transit stays long.
Nearer-airfield/farther-airborne spawn rules, era eligibility and real fuel validation remain required.

acceptanceBeforeImplementation: Implement selected full_taiwan_strait bounds, verify entire Taiwan main island remains present, retain mainland coast/Penghu/Kinmen/Matsu, and never switch back to a partial comparison option without user steering.
All candidate airfields receive dated source geometry, era-specific fixture labels, takeoff/landing/fuel checks and nearer-field/farther-airborne spawn validation.
Full selected bounds have tile inventory, license/datum/checksum provenance, coastline mask and representative source-to-engine coordinate checks.
The selected land-component ground-sector route graph is connected, bridges are typed/validated, and no land-route edge crosses open water; main-island options include a main-island ground sector.

At least one complete transport embark→sea transit→disembark→owned-company continuation is demonstrated with preserved life/ammo/damage; time0 standby ships and fictional beachheads are clearly distinguished from dynamic reinforcement voyages.
Accepted terrain/contact, runway/bridge repairs, AI/player damage, intel and company ownership obey existing source-matched native/WASM/replay requirements.
A45min and90min fixture each demonstrate meaningful ground play and air support for their permitted early/late-era roster without time/distance compression.

Demonstrate whole-island terrain streaming and strategic map while a16–24human combined fixture retains an active focused battle, physical distant companies/ships and correct nearshore standby versus new strategic transport ETAs.

Nearby field start and farther-rear airborne start stay as agreed. Voluntary long flights remain physically possible within the world and do not receive hidden transit shortcuts.
